history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#721; borg-reborn-rs #1061, PR #1090 at 9276b75a, synchronized with track-p 69a5ff40; the earlier pilot reborn-stairscum1061-pilot, run 45112130177, was at 0d09e318, stair_scum alone, and does not carry over). The shipped build ships stair_scum on at the owner's settings (stair_scum_max_hp 20; slack steps by class: Druid and Necromancer 1, Mage and Priest 2, Ranger and Rogue 3, Paladin and Blackguard 4; Warrior off; level rate 50) and #1085's breadth-first exploration. The class lines win over any common value, so the four arms vary only what has no class line: shipped (none); noscum (stair_scum 0, breadth-first alone); nobfs (explore_breadth_first 0, stair_scum alone); neither (both 0, the play before either mode, the control). The other session's seven-arm pilot of #721 (level0, hp25, kitleash) is separate. Owner, 2026-11-23: "I need a bigger sample for stair scum": the pilot as the gate, then the four ladder tiers (verysmall, small-rest, medium, big = classes-1800 starts 1-900), read pooled (RULES 14).
Tier small-rest: classes-1800 small-rest (starts 46-90), one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, 100,000 turns, specimen 9276b75a. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm. Report, paired by start against neither: all deaths and deaths at CL <= 2 and on DL1 (rescued and newly killed, exact McNemar), per class; shipped against noscum (what stair_scum adds on top of breadth-first) and shipped against nobfs (what breadth-first adds on top of stair_scum); the progress cost: starts reaching DL3, DL4 and DL5 (exact McNemar by start), mean final CL, first turn at max HP 20 and 25 and at CL5 (#718's fields), per class; pilot evidence: the stair_scum notes per game. Descriptive (RULES 14).
